title: Heterogeneous biased monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p$ assign a real parameter to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $S$ be a set of coordinates, and let $x$ be a sign vector. The heterogeneous biased monomial indexed by $S$ is the product, over coordinates in $S$, of the standardized biased sign at that coordinate, evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a real parameter for each coordinate
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the standardized biased sign.
